image_description: A large, pale yellow cylindrical plastic barrel (rain barrel) sits on a concrete base outdoors. A young girl with brown hair is leaning over the open top of the barrel, looking inside. The barrel has a black rim/lid structure at the top. To the right, there are colorful ropes or fabrics (yellow, orange, blue) draped near the base. In the background, there is a metal fence and a blue recycling bin.
